Description: Adjusts boundary constants (c + 1, c - 1) on counter wraps and terminal counts
Flips clock edge (posedge/negedge), reset condition, or reset value in sequential logic
Forces signal assignments stuck-at-0 or stuck-at-1 on output registers
Replaces logical connectors (&& <-> ||) in branching conditions
Replaces arithmetic operators (+ <-> -) in data-path logic
